results.summary: Q3 FY2026: Revenue $82.9B (+18% YoY), AI run-rate $37B (+123% YoY), Azure +40%, Copilot 20M paid seats. CY2026 capex target ~$190B (23% above analyst expectations). Raymond James downgrade May 5 (Xbox -33%). MSFT down ~15.7% YTD. Stock price ~$413.54 on May 6. Cash dividend $0.91 (ex-date May 21). OpenAI exclusivity ended — Microsoft no longer sole cloud for OpenAI products.
